editorial:
Imagine stepping back into that wild, puzzle-filled world where everything is a bit off and nothing is what it seems. You get to follow a new set of heroes who stumble into the Labyrinth, facing off against strange creatures and tricky riddles. The vibe is a perfect mix of a creepy fairy tale and a colorful playground, making you feel like a kid again. It captures that same magical energy from the first movie but adds a fresh layer of weirdness that keeps you guessing about what is around the next corner.

Everything about the look of this film is top-notch, from the puppet work to the bright costumes. While the middle part drags a bit, the big finale makes up for it with some really cool action scenes. You should definitely check this out if you love fantasy adventures that don't take themselves too seriously. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the tiny details of the creatures. If you are a huge fan, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: You find out that the main character was actually a puppet all along, controlled by the Goblin King to test the other heroes. Once the final puzzle is solved, the Labyrinth collapses and sends everyone back to the real world. The characters realize that the magic was actually inside them the whole time. They say a final goodbye to the Goblin King, who promises to return one day, and the screen fades to black.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves puppets and magic adventures.
